stage: BNR Matched Prudential Source Discovery and Exact Source Enumeration
scope: Close the source-discovery stage for the definitionally matched BNR prudential controls without manufacturing URLs, promoting unmatched CBD2 data, peeking at model outcomes, or extracting numeric values before the source map is reproducible.

semantic_anchor.source_family: BNR Monthly Bulletin, Statistical Section, 11.1 Main prudential indicators
semantic_anchor.population: Banks that are Romanian legal entities; the bulletin footnote is the governing population boundary.
semantic_anchor.npl_inception: BNR methodological notes state that the NPL ratio according to the EBA definition is calculated starting in December 2015.

discovery_channels.fallback_evidence: February 2017 bulletin is independently identified for methodology/layout evidence but remains non-selected because January 2017 primary status is unresolved.

official_public_surface_findings.finding: BNR exposes the official interactive database as a statistics service, but the current public crawl surface does not expose a complete series catalogue for the target prudential controls.

The current BNR statistics navigation exposes banking-risk pages for the Credit Risk Register and Payment Incidents Register and separately exposes the interactive database; this does not prove prudential-series absence, but no exact target series identifier is exposed in the audited public surface.
BNR methodological notes define the EBA NPL ratio and state that it is calculated starting with December 2015.
BNR Monthly Bulletin Table 11.1 publishes exact prudential-table values and states the Romanian-legal-entity-bank population boundary.

exhaustion_assessment.reason: The admissible public discovery channels have been searched without yielding either the complete 11-year exact primary PDF map or a stable official machine-readable target series. Repeating the same search/index probes cannot improve scientific identification without new provider-side evidence.

reopen_triggers: BNR exposes an exact official primary Monthly Bulletin URL for any unresolved year through an archive/search/browser surface.

BNR exposes a stable interactive-database dataset/series identifier or official CSV/XLS/XML/API export for the total-capital ratio and EBA NPL ratio with the Romanian-legal-entity-bank population documented.
BNR publishes a machine-readable prudential dataset or metadata catalogue that establishes the same population and variable definitions.
BNR publishes an explicit population/consolidation bridge to another official machine-readable source.
non_reopen_conditions: Repeating the same search-engine queries without a new official clue.
Guessing historical PDF filenames, directories, upload timestamps or internal endpoints.
Using a February/December fallback solely because the January primary is not indexed.
Using numerical similarity between CBD2 and BNR values.
Using third-party reproductions as canonical source evidence.
